mechanism: Ginseng induces CYP3A4 metabolism of tacrolimus, reducing tacrolimus concentrations and therapeutic immunosuppression, while also potentially enhancing immune function through ginsenoside compounds, counteracting tacrolimus immunosuppressive effects.
action: Advise patients to avoid ginseng supplementation during tacrolimus therapy; if ginseng use is necessary, monitor tacrolimus blood levels closely and adjust dosing accordingly to maintain therapeutic concentrations.
